video_title: Why I Left the NBA to Play in Greece

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his decision to play for Aris Thessaloniki
quotes.excerpt: This year I'll be playing for Aris Thessaloniki, I'm actually back home in Greece.
quotes.quote: This year I'll be playing for Aris Thessaloniki, I'm actually back home in Greece. I'm loving it, it's amazing. The fans are, you know, this is one of the reasons I started playing basketball. This is going to be an amazing season, I just feel it.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the unique experience of playing basketball in Greece
quotes.excerpt: I wish any player that plays this sport could get a chance to play for one month.
quotes.quote: Me being back home, I'm loving it. I wish any player that plays this sport could get a chance to play for one month in Greece to understand what the love of playing basketball is there and how it is, especially for these teams. I'm playing in a pretty good team.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the high demand for Aris Thessaloniki tickets
quotes.excerpt: You don't understand, tickets are sold out. Jerseys are sold out. You can't get anything.
quotes.quote: You don't understand, tickets are sold out. Jerseys are sold out. You can't get anything. Like we even as players, we are trying to get some. We've built this team and now we can't get anything. We can't get anything, you know, and it's special.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the motivation behind his career choices
quotes.excerpt: Ever since my dad passed away, I have to do for everybody else.
quotes.quote: Ever since my dad passed away, this actually happened to me because I think when our dad passed away, I have to do for everybody else. I have to, have to, have to, have to. And then it just became second nature because that's how I am as a person too. I'm very dependable.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the team's winning mentality
quotes.excerpt: Whatever we go, we win. That's what we do. We don't play to just play.
quotes.quote: Whatever we go, we win. That's what we do. That's why I don't know any other way. That's how we play. We don't play to just play. That's why you see we start with defense first, we do all the hustle, we do all these things because we know that's what it takes to win.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on prioritizing family over basketball
quotes.excerpt: I'm a brother before a basketball player. I'm a big brother before anything else.
quotes.quote: I'm a brother before a basketball player. I don't know how you want to connect me towards basketball. I'm a big brother before anything else. I'm a son, I'm all these others, but before anything else, to have to make sure that everybody is okay, plays a big role.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the emotional weight of giving his brother an assist
quotes.excerpt: I almost fumbled because I wanted to give him an assist.
quotes.quote: I almost fumbled because I wanted to give him an assist. I was looking for him the whole game. Let me get him one, let me get him one, because I know my dad is watching. I know for a fact that if my dad would watch me do this.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on his commitment to winning
quotes.excerpt: As long as I'm needed and we can win games, I'll play.
quotes.quote: I always feel as long as I'm needed and we can win games, I'll play.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the importance of creating your own path
quotes.excerpt: Stop thinking where do you fit with everybody else left and right and start creating your own mountain.
quotes.quote: Stop thinking where do you fit with everybody else left and right and start creating your own mountain. What is the thing that you do that nobody is even close to? I can give you three things. Three things, right away.

quotes.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Thanasis Antetokounmpo on the disrespect shown to Rudy Gobert
quotes.excerpt: To think that Rudy Gobert or any other player that plays basketball sucks is wild.
quotes.quote: That is to me, to think that Rudy Gobert or any other player that plays basketball sucks is wild. Because think about this, he gets paid to play basketball. He gets paid by a very wealthy human being, whoever owns that team, to play basketball. That person who is paying them is wealthy for a reason. They're not just throwing money at bad players.
